title: Extensions of Robbins-Siegmund Theorem with Applications in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2509.26442v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Robbins-Siegmund theorem establishes the convergence of stochastic processes that are almost supermartingales and is one of the most commonly used approaches for analyzing stochastic iterative algorithms in stochastic approximation and reinforcement learning (RL). However, its original form has a significant limitation as it requires the zero-order term to be summable. In many important RL applications, this summable condition, however, cannot be met. This limitation motivates us to extend the Robbins-Siegmund theorem for almost supermartingales where the zero-order term is not summable, but only square-summable. In particular, we introduce a novel and mild assumption on the increments of the stochastic processes. This together with the square-summable condition enables an almost sure convergence to a bounded set. Additionally, we further provide almost sure convergence rates, high probability concentration bounds, and $L^p$ conv

translated_title: 罗宾斯-西格蒙德定理的扩展及其在强化学习中的应用
translated_abstract: 罗宾斯-西格蒙德定理确立了近似上鞅随机过程的收敛性，是分析随机逼近和强化学习中随机迭代算法最常用的方法之一。然而，其原始形式存在一个显著的局限性，即要求零阶项可求和。在许多重要的强化学习应用中，这一可求和条件无法得到满足。这一局限性促使我们扩展罗宾斯-西格蒙德定理，使其适用于零阶项不可求和、但仅平方可求和的近似上鞅情形。特别地，我们对随机过程的增量引入了一个新颖且温和的假设，该假设与平方可求和条件相结合，能够实现几乎必然收敛到一个有界集合。此外，我们进一步提供了几乎必然收敛速率、高概率集中界以及 L^p 收敛等结果。
tldr: 本文扩展了罗宾斯-西格蒙德定理，将零阶项的条件从可求和放宽为平方可求和，并通过一个新颖温和的增量假设实现了几乎必然收敛到有界集合，同时给出了收敛速率、高概率集中界和 L^p 收敛，从而适用于更广泛的强化学习场景。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Robbins-Siegmund theorem by relaxing the zero-order term condition from summable to square-summable, introducing a novel mild assumption on process increments to achieve almost sure convergence to a bounded set, with convergence rates, high-probability concentration bounds, and L^p convergence for broader reinforcement learning applications.
